build.name: cmake + make (library and its test/tool programs)
build.cmd: mkdir -p $BODY/build/lc && cd $BODY/build/lc && cmake $BODY/upstream/tree >/dev/null 2>&1 && make -s 2>&1 | grep -iE '\berror' | head -3; ls tests 2>/dev/null | head; test -f lib/libcorrect.a -o -f libcorrect.a && echo built

runs.name: convolutional codes: noise injection then Viterbi decode (upstream test)
Reed-Solomon: error/erasure injection then decode (upstream test)

notes: PAIR: the tests are corruption <-> decoder. Test binary names are resolved after the first build (recorded in the receipt's stdout).
